binarySource: v2.7.0 Windows production installer build, monitoring off

method.settings: Isolated NetMask settings and WebView2 data, Paper theme, automatic OS mutations disabled; temporary loopback WebView2 debugging enabled only by the harness
method.privateCommit: GetProcessMemoryInfo PrivateUsage; committed private bytes, including nonresident pages
method.workload: Actual local saved networks; no speed test, update download, DNS change, rename, reconnect, registry change, or credential access

method.privateWorkingSet: QueryWorkingSet resident pages with the Shared bit unset, summed across the host and descendants
